name: trace
description: A /trace pane with two tabs: the skills that loaded this session (when, from where, who invoked them, how large) and the web pages Claude fetched or saw in search results, ready to insert as citations

skills_max_entries.title: Skills: max entries
skills_max_entries.description: How many skill loads the Skills tab keeps; the oldest drop off first. Per-skill counts are kept regardless.

skills_show_args.title: Skills: record arguments
skills_show_args.description: Record and show the arguments each skill was invoked with (truncated to 80 characters).

skills_status_line.title: Skills: status line count
skills_status_line.description: Show a compact skill-load count in the status line under the prompt.

sources_citation_format.title: Sources: citation format
sources_citation_format.description: How Insert citations writes the list: markdown (- [Title](url)) or numbered ([1] Title. url).

sources_cite_search_results.title: Sources: cite search results
sources_cite_search_results.description: Also cite pages that only appeared in search results. Off: only pages Claude fetched successfully are cited.

sources_extra_tools.title: Sources: extra fetch tools
sources_extra_tools.description: Comma-separated names of other tools that fetch a URL, recorded like WebFetch, e.g. mcp__fetch__fetch. Empty: WebFetch and WebSearch only.

sources_url_arg.title: Sources: URL argument of extra tools
sources_url_arg.description: The argument that holds the URL in the extra fetch tools' calls.

sources_project_history.title: Sources: keep project history
sources_project_history.description: Also keep the sources of every session in this project, on disk in the plugin's store, and add a pane button to show them.
